payload.title: Run the wake guard check on a real site (PPY-a5513c live proof)
payload.description: Live proof of the once-only create, waiting for Ryan's approval and a site on a release with wake keys (5.130 or later). Code and procedure merged in PR #1639 (PPY-a5513c): see docs/procedure-runner.md, section 'Proving the once-only create on a real site'. Acceptance: on one site, 'papyrus --site <site> procedures check-wake-guard --procedure-key <key without required parameters> --json' prints status proved (first answer duplicate false, second duplicate true, same run id); one run record for the wake key, outcome nothing, reason wake_guard_check. Record the JSON on this task and on PPY-567bf9. Blocks PPY-567bf9 (B1).
